explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain exactly why the optimal objective drops from 1000 to 800 even though the business brief adds destination-by-day structure and a new gate rule. Trace the change through the code by naming the original variable/constraint (`x_truck`, `Min_Truck_Trips`) and the revised replacements (`x_truck[sp][d]`, `Min_Total_Truck_Trips`, `z_mode[sp][d]` / `exclusive_mode_sp`), and tie them to the exact `general_parameters.csv` fields and values, especially `min_truck_trips` and `max_total_pollution`, plus the sales-point share fields. Then use the LP-relaxation diagnostics to identify which original and revised constraints are binding or slack, interpret the shadow price on the truck-minimum constraint in business terms, and explain why that marginal value cannot be linearly extrapolated after the revision with the binary mode gate and per-sales-point/day structure.
